name: ricky-mobile-store
description: Ricky Mobile Store - Monorepo for Backend API, Admin Management System, and Customer Storefront

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix store_backend install && npm --prefix store-management-system install && npm --prefix store-web install
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix store_backend run build && npm --prefix store-management-system run build && npm --prefix store-web run build
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,ADMIN,STOREFRONT" -c "blue.bold,green.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:storefront"
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix store_backend test && npm --prefix store-management-system test && npm --prefix store-web test
scripts.typecheck:all: npm --prefix store_backend run typecheck && npm --prefix store-management-system run typecheck && npm --prefix store-web run typecheck
scripts.format:all: npm --prefix store_backend run format && npm --prefix store-management-system run format && npm --prefix store-web run format
scripts.lint:all:fix: npm --prefix store_backend run lint && npm --prefix store-management-system run lint:fix
scripts.setup:all: npm run install:all && npm run build:all

author: Karanveer Thour
